evals.name: init-project
evals.prompt: I just opened up the Schedules folder for a new project — W9990 Salt Flats Test Temple — and want to set it up. Initialize the project with: SmartPM project URL https://live.smartpmtech.com/#/v2/39032af1-4b5c-4d22-a81e-9f7c7aabfbc5/projects/990123, SmartPM card name 'Salt Flats Test Temple', Procore project ID 5550000. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks get_project(W9990), finds no row, gathers the binding fields conversationally, and persists them by calling the upsert_project MCP tool with job_number='W9990' and source='init'. It stores the SmartPM v2 base URL (live.smartpmtech.com/#/v2/...) and the trends (?view=Graphs) / change-log (/changes) URLs — NOT the old /projects/{id}/workspace host or ?tab=Graphs / /changelog derivation. It does NOT set spm_project_id to the SmartPM project id. It does NOT generate a project-context.html file. It drops the Write Weekly Schedule Email launcher scripts into the Schedules folder.
expectations: The agent called get_project with job_number 'W9990' before writing anything
The agent called upsert_project with job_number 'W9990' and the gathered bindings (source='init')
The agent did NOT create or generate a project-context.html file

The agent stored SmartPM v2 URLs (live.smartpmtech.com/#/v2/...) — trends ending in ?view=Graphs and change log ending in /changes — NOT the old /projects/{id}/workspace host, ?tab=Graphs, or /changelog
The agent did NOT set spm_project_id to the SmartPM project id (it is a FK to spm_projects.id)
The agent passed procore_company_id='11093' and procore_project_id='5550000'
The agent did NOT ask for contractual completion, recipients, or signer info (those are not stored in wnd_projects)
The agent copied 'Write Weekly Schedule Email.bat' (and the .ps1) into the Schedules folder

evals.name: update-smartpm-url
evals.prompt: Update the SmartPM URL on W9990 — it moved to https://live.smartpmtech.com/#/v2/39032af1-4b5c-4d22-a81e-9f7c7aabfbc5/projects/990456. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}. The project is already initialized.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the existing row via get_project(W9990), then calls upsert_project with only the changed SmartPM URL fields (the v2 base plus the matching trends ?view=Graphs / change-log /changes URLs). Partial update — other bindings untouched. No HTML is generated.
expectations: The agent called get_project with job_number 'W9990'
The agent called upsert_project with the updated smartpm_url (the v2 base) and the matching smartpm_trends_url (?view=Graphs) / smartpm_changelog_url (/changes)
The agent did NOT generate a project-context.html file
The agent did NOT re-send unrelated bindings it was not asked to change (partial upsert)

evals.name: lazy-migrate-legacy-html
evals.prompt: Set up W9990 for the weekly update. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH} and there's an old project-context.html sitting in it from before we moved to the database.
evals.expected_output: The agent calls get_project(W9990), gets null, finds the legacy project-context.html, parses it with parse_project_context_html, maps bindings via parsed_context_to_project_row and upserts them with source='migrated', replays each log entry via append_project_log (preserving dates), then retires the file to project-context-migrated.html via retire_context_html. It does NOT regenerate the HTML and does NOT Read/Edit/Write the HTML directly.
expectations: The agent called get_project with job_number 'W9990' and got no row
The agent parsed the legacy file via parse_project_context_html (not a direct Read of the HTML)
The agent called upsert_project with source='migrated' using the mapped binding columns
The agent replayed any project log entries via append_project_log
The agent retired the file to project-context-migrated.html (did not leave a live project-context.html)
The agent did NOT generate a new project-context.html
The agent did NOT use Edit or Write on the HTML file
